risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, app.module.ts, entry.ts, union / linking / identity read ports). Worker entry starts the optional order-sync runtime the existing optional way (handler registered once; no dispatch, query or timer at module init or entry start — the frozen zero-dispatch tests stay green); OrdersModule.forWorker wires the B1-08h attribution pipeline with the B1-08i update step and the platform event bus (alerts and domain events on the same bus); SyncAccessPort provides queryableAccount (only a live endpoint with exactly one account per platform); status-map CSVs read once per scheduled platform. Cross-module data only through the union / identity / linking read ports exported from their index.ts. Settlement rebate port is a TODO no-op until settlement exists. Documented defaults per the brief.
